one_line: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, Microsoft faces a PyPI supply chain compromise, and industry players navigate major AI infrastructure investments and security challenges.

themes.title: Google launches new Gemini and Genie models
themes.text: Google DeepMind released the Gemini 4 Neon midtier model with a 1 million-token context window and the Genie 4 interactive world model with native audio.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon model for complex workflows

Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model with native audio

themes.title: Security incidents target AI packages and agents
themes.text: Hackers compromised Microsoft's official Agent Framework PyPI package with a credential stealer, while Meta faced alarms over Muse AI privacy leaks.

stories.headline: Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI package compromised with credential stealer

themes.title: Tech giants shift spending and structure for AI
themes.text: Tencent's capital expenditures surged 527% due to AI infrastructure investments, and Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as part of its shift to an AI-first business.
